senses.en_definition: An order or instruction directing someone to do something.
An order, prohibition, or regulation issued by a government or other authority that must be obeyed.
A spoken command given during military drill or a similar activity.

messages.en: Don't take that hill road. The police have ordered it closed because of a landslide.
Oh, no wonder so many cars are turning back. I'll just take the main road, then.
Yes, go that way. It's okay if you're a bit late, as long as you're safe.

senses.en_definition: A journey or the act of travelling from one place to another.
The operation or progress of an organisation, activity, or process.
The flow or circulation of a liquid, such as water or oil.

messages.en: Are you here yet? I'm already waiting in the lobby.
I'm still on my way. There's a bit of traffic, so I'll probably be there in another ten minutes.
Okay, I'll just wait here. Text me when you're close, okay?

senses.en_definition: An agreement between two or more parties, including a contract or a treaty between countries.
Testament, as used in the names of the two main divisions of the Christian Bible.

messages.en: Have you read that tenancy agreement yet? Don't just sign it without reading it.
I haven't finished yet, sis. I don't quite understand this bit about the deposit.
Send me a photo of that bit. Let's read through it together first, then ask the landlord.

senses.en_definition: Marriage or the act of getting married; also, a wedding.
A union or blending of two different elements.

collocations.en: a marriage of tradition and modernity
a marriage of art and technology

messages.en: My sister's wedding is this Sunday. Want to come? You can bring your younger sibling along too.
I'd love to! I'll come with my younger sibling. Send me the location, okay? I've never been to that hall.
